source.title: G3 Basic Canonical Canvas Implementation Plan v0.2
source.trusted_section: WP G3-08 — Add demo-only camera, HitTest and transient selection harness

trusted_statements.goal: Add demo-only pan, zoom, G2-authoritative hit testing, and transient selection without establishing G4 production interaction contracts.
consumes: G2 Scene::hitTest and its spatial-candidate then precise-hit pipeline
ObjectId as an observation-only transient selection identity
produces: CameraController with invertible world/view transforms, pan, and anchored zoom
DemoTransientSnapshot carrying demo-only selected ObjectId and overlay identity
forbidden: production EditorSession, SelectionSession, tool, history, or operation design
